name: Brimstone Rain

source.title: Pathfinder Lost Omens Cheliax, Infernal Inheritance

text:
Globs of smoldering brimstone erupt from the earth, dealing 8d6 fire damage to each creature in the area with a basic Reflex save and choking them with sulfurous fumes. For the duration, the area is difficult terrain, and breathing creatures that start their turn in the area must succeed at a Fortitude save or take @item.level - 3d6 persistent,poison damage; this is an inhaled poison effect. On a critical failure, they're also Sickened 1. You can Dismiss the spell.

---
Heightened (+1) The fire damage increases by 1d6, and the persistent poison damage increases by 1d6.
